candidates.source_name: НБУ — новини з тегом "обговорення" (drafts_discussion) / NBU news tagged drafts_discussion
candidates.why_relevant: This tag is the de-facto NBU public-consultation feed. Every launch of a громадське обговорення is announced as a news item carrying the tag 'drafts_discussion' (displayed as 'обговорення'), with the draft resolution, the regulatory impact analysis, the comparison table and the closing date for comments. Confirmed on a live item (26.08.2026 cash-handling Instruction draft, comments due 04.09.2026).
candidates.legal_status: official public-sector information, reuse permitted with attribution
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Daily HTTP GET with a browser User-Agent (WebFetch-class fetchers get 403; plain curl with UA returns 200). The tag query string is not always honoured server-side on /ua/news/all, so crawl the news list and keep items whose detail page contains 'tags=drafts_discussion'; parse the closing date from the phrase 'Зауваження та пропозиції ... приймаються ... до <date> включно'.
candidates.discovered_via_method: crawled bank.gov.ua/ua/regulatory-activity and extracted the internal tag link, then verified the tag on a live consultation article

negative_findings.description: The NBU has no standalone '/legislation/drafts' or '/publicdiscussion' page. Both guesses returned HTTP 404 (/ua/legislation/drafts, /ua/about/publicdiscussion). Consultations are surfaced only through the tagged news stream (drafts_discussion) plus the /ua/regulatory-activity hub.
negative_findings.result_summary: Two plausible section URLs 404; the real entry points are /ua/regulatory-activity, /ua/regulatory-activity/planning and the tag-filtered news list.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: A collector designed around a 'consultations page' assumption will silently collect nothing. The tag+news architecture must be modelled explicitly.

negative_findings.description: Four candidate RSS endpoints on bank.gov.ua (/ua/rss, /ua/rss/all, /rss/all, /ua/news/rss) all returned HTTP 404.
negative_findings.result_summary: No RSS/Atom feed discovered for NBU news or consultations in this run.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Collection must be HTML-scraping-based with change detection, which is more brittle and needs a monitoring alert when the page structure changes.

negative_findings.description: The tags=drafts_discussion query parameter is not consistently applied server-side: /ua/news?tags=drafts_discussion returned a generic 42-item news list including monetary-policy and numismatics items, while /ua/news/all?tags=drafts_discussion returned only 10 links. The tag is however reliably present on the detail page of a genuine consultation article.
negative_findings.result_summary: Tag filtering must be done client-side by the collector, on the detail page, not trusted from the list URL.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Naively trusting the tag URL produces both false positives (unrelated news) and false negatives (missed consultations).

negative_findings.description: bank.gov.ua returns HTTP 403 to the WebFetch-class fetcher on every path tried, while returning HTTP 200 to curl with a desktop User-Agent on the same paths.
negative_findings.result_summary: Bot-defended, not dead. Hypothesis only — a deterministic verification pass should confirm.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The single most important host in this cell would be wrongly marked dead by a naive liveness checker.

negative_findings.description: drs.gov.ua/regulatory_policy/ returned 403; mof.gov.ua/uk/proekti-aktiv-dlja-obgovorennja returned 403; kmu.gov.ua redirected to a validate.perfdrive.com ShieldSquare bot-check interstitial.
negative_findings.result_summary: Three adjacent Ukrainian government hosts refused plain HTTP clients in this run; all three are indexed and linked, so presumed live.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: These carry the oversight and methodology layer of the RIA process; collection needs a headless browser, not plain HTTP.

negative_findings.description: Two candidate Ukrainian financial-association domains failed at the network layer: uafic.com.ua (connection refused) and www.vaib.com.ua (DNS resolution failure). nabu.ua returned HTTP 429.
negative_findings.result_summary: No verified URL obtained for the finance-companies/insurance association layer in this run; these domain guesses may simply be wrong rather than the organisations being absent.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Non-bank associations are the organised respondents to a large share of NBU consultations; leaving them uncovered biases the industry-reaction signal towards banks only.

negative_findings.description: No NBU page was found that publishes the received comments, the respondents, or the regulator's reasoned response to them ('звіт про результати обговорення' / feedback statement). The consultation notice states comments are accepted via a template to an address, but the responses do not appear to be published.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searched the regulatory-activity hub and a live consultation article; only inbound materials (draft, RIA, comparison table, comment template) were found — no outbound feedback statement.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Without a published feedback statement, the only way to see who influenced a rule is to diff the consulted draft against the enacted act and to track association positions separately.

coverage_gaps.description: No archive or index of CLOSED consultations was located. The tagged news stream is chronological and the drafts_discussion items age out of the visible list; there is no year-scoped consultation register comparable to the Ministry of Finance's 'Проекти регуляторних актів для обговорення у 2026 р.'.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Build the historical series ourselves: paginate the NBU news archive backwards with the tag test applied per item, and cross-fill from Wayback Machine snapshots of /ua/regulatory-activity and from pravo.ua / LIGA:ZAKON coverage. Also probe whether the legislation search supports a date-ranged crawl of type=11/13/21.

coverage_gaps.description: Comment deadlines exist only as free Ukrainian prose inside the article body ('Зауваження та пропозиції ... приймаються ... до 04 вересня 2026 року включно'), with Ukrainian month names and occasional variants ('до <date> включно', 'протягом ... днів'). There is no machine-readable deadline field anywhere.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Write and unit-test a Ukrainian date parser covering the month-name genitive forms and the 'включно' / 'протягом N днів з дня оприлюднення' variants; fail loudly rather than silently dropping an item whose deadline cannot be parsed.

coverage_gaps.description: The banking association (НАБУ) and the payments association (ЕМА) were identified, but no verified source was obtained for the finance-companies, insurance, credit-union or leasing associations that respond to the large non-bank share of NBU consultations.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run a dedicated local-language actor-mapping pass on 'асоціація фінансових компаній', 'асоціація страховиків України', 'всеукраїнська асоціація кредитних спілок', 'асоціація лізингодавців' and verify the real domains rather than guessing them.

coverage_gaps.description: The English mirror of the consultation feed returned fewer items than the Ukrainian one (7 vs 10 detail links in the same probe), and the substantive attachments (проєкт постанови, аналіз впливу, порівняльна таблиця) are Ukrainian-only.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Treat Ukrainian as the authoritative collection language and English strictly as an enrichment layer; budget for machine translation of the PDF/DOCX payloads rather than relying on the EN site.

coverage_gaps.description: Every high-value host in this cell (bank.gov.ua, drs.gov.ua, mof.gov.ua, kmu.gov.ua) is bot-defended to some degree, and nabu.ua rate-limits. Plain HTTP fetching is not a sufficient collection technology for this cell.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Provision a headless-browser collection path with realistic headers, per-host rate limits and exponential backoff on 429; explicitly encode 403/429 as 'retry with browser', never as 'dead source'.

coverage_gaps.description: The link between a Verkhovna Rada bill and the NBU sub-legislation it triggers is not yet mapped; the Rada portal was identified but no keyword/committee filter was validated for banking and payments bills.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Validate a query against itd.rada.gov.ua/billinfo and the profile committee on financial policy and banking, and define the join key (act reference, subject keywords) that links a bill to the subsequent NBU consultation.

brief: The NBU runs public consultations without a dedicated consultations page: every громадське обговорення is published as a news item carrying the tag 'drafts_discussion' (shown as 'обговорення'), whose body states the comment deadline in Ukrainian prose and whose attachments follow a strict, date-stamped pattern at /admin_uploads/article/ — proekt_YYYY-MM-DD (draft postanova), analiz_YYYY-MM-DD (аналіз регуляторного впливу), tabl_proekt_YYYY-MM-DD (порівняльна таблиця), plus a fixed shablon_propozyciy.xlsx comment template. Upstream of that, /ua/regulatory-activity/planning publishes notices that work on a draft act has started, been suspended or postponed, and the legislation search exposes typed document classes 11 (plan of draft regulatory acts), 13 (regulatory activity) and 21 (effectiveness-tracking schedule), giving a two-tier early-warning structure ahead of the consultation itself; white papers and консультаційні документи sit even earlier. The main operational risks are technical rather than informational: bank.gov.ua and the adjacent government hosts (drs.gov.ua, mof.gov.ua, kmu.gov.ua) are bot-defended and return 403 to naive fetchers while serving normally to browser-like clients, no RSS exists, the tag query parameter is not reliably applied server-side, and no closed-consultation archive or published feedback statement was found. Industry reaction — the dimension the regulator never publishes — has to be picked up separately from НАБУ, ЕМА, the Ukrainian financial and legal press, and law-firm digests such as PwC Ukraine and CMS.
